en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, or said Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdul Rahman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> bequeathed, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Abu Neyzara, and Rabaha, and Jubeyr
would be emancipated upon (a stipulation) that they work in the treasury for five years’.
